paper_id: LightRouter_ Towards Efficient LLM Collaboration with Minimal Overhead
title: LightRouter: Towards Efficient LLM Collaboration with Minimal Overhead
motivation: LLM选择面临性能与成本的权衡困境，单模型不稳定，传统集成方法计算开销过大
problem_framing: 如何在有限预算下最大化语义一致性S(Y_final, Y_true) - λT_total
key_insight: 受Kubernetes启发，先用boot tokens快速探测模型潜力，仅让top-k模型继续生成以控制成本
method_signature: 两阶段自适应选择：boot tokens初筛+top-k聚合
evaluation_criteria: 多基准准确率与推理成本的帕累托最优权衡
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: MoA有效性不保证，对候选池组成高度敏感；当前仅支持非推理模型，无法限制CoT长度
evidence_for_taste: lightweight GET requests for status checking
the most promising workloads for resource allocation
the 200-token budget represents an effective balance point
LightRouter consistently lies on the Pareto frontier
thinking_moves: 从分布式系统调度思想获得启发
将模型选择建模为方差缩减的聚合问题
用boot tokens实现早期截断决策
通过帕累托最优性定义方法有效性
